channel.title: Violations Watch: Iraq
channel.description: New incidents reported in Iraq. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: NetBlocks confirms Telegram is restricted on multiple internet providers in Iraq, with authorities citing extremist content and national security (NetBlocks)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Iraq. Types: Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Iraqi authorities (per NetBlocks). 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1297

item.title: Iraqi security forces open fire on a family car during an arrest operation at a checkpoint in Diyala, killing three children and injuring five people; the family disputes the claim that a wanted suspect was in the car (The New Region)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Dar Al-Salam sub-district, Diyala, Iraq. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Iraqi security forces. Reported casualties: 3 killed, 5 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Family disputes the security forces' account; date not stated. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1355
